thread:
mila: emergency culture poll: do we recognize the Midnight Cookie Cartel as an official office guild? :cookie:
ash: officially? absolutely. unofficially? definitely. longest-running mystery supply chain in the building.
ron: are there bylaws? do we need an oath?
penelope: oath is simple: bring cookies, share cookies, never reveal cookie sources. secrecy is part of the charm.
kudos-bot: Reminder: please log any food donations to the communal spreadsheet for accounting.
mila: fair. rule proposal: cartel members wear a tiny sticker on Fridays. stickers distributed from the pastry-safe.
ash: sticker design idea: a cookie with sunglasses and a tiny fedora. classy.
penelope: i can make stickers. also proposing a rotating "Master of Midnight Bakes" title for the person who clandestinely replenishes snacks after hours.
ron: nomination: last week's salted chocolate croissant saboteur gets the first title. that was legendary.
kitchen-bot: :bell: Kitchen etiquette reminder: label perishable items with date and initials. no unattended cream.
mila: logistics: membership is voluntary. benefits include first dibs on crumbs and a secret emoji :cookie_heist:. obligations: bring at least one midnight treat per quarter.
ash: serious question: can membership be revoked for shameless taste-testing and not replacing? proposing a gentle penalty: one week of dish duty and a public haiku apology.
penelope: haiku penalty approved. also thinking of cartographic artifacts: a tiny map behind the coffee shelf marking approximate stash coordinates (vague by design).
ron: lore addition: there should be a folklore tale about the Great Almond Flour Heist of '21. i will draft in the lore binder.
mila: binder live in the kitchen under "Snacks & Myths". i'll laminate the first page. protect the myths.
kudos-bot: :trophy: Suggestion: occasional formal recognition in All Hands for heroic midnight bakes. short mention, high prestige.
ash: cultural enforcement: any non-member caught hoarding cookies without sharing will be asked to perform interpretive dancing in the kitchen. low trauma, high entertainment.
penelope: performance art clause noted. also silent contribution channel for folks who bake but don't want attention: #cookie-anons.
ron: secret channel? perfect. we can call it "crumb-ops". tiny slow-burn thread culture.
mila: vote time: :thumbsup: to recognize the Midnight Cookie Cartel as an official informal guild with stickers, a lore binder, and the Master of Midnight Bakes title. react now.
kudos-bot: tallying reactions...
kitchen-bot: :white_check_mark: majority achieved. cartel recognized. stickers to be distributed Friday 10:00 in the kitchen.
penelope: first official act: i hereby donate 12 mini-scones to the cause. anonymous, of course.
ash: long live the Cartel. may our crumbs be many and our emergencies be edible.
ron: agreed. new office motto: "In crumbs we trust."
mila: closing ceremonial note: if you find a tiny sticker under a plate this week, consider it a blessing.
